source_row.rationale: Cyanide poisoning, which can occur from combustion of certain synthetic materials in structure fires (in addition to other exposure sources), impairs cellular oxygen utilization at the mitochondrial level, causing severe metabolic (lactic) acidosis and cardiovascular/neurological compromise, notably even when pulse oximetry oxygen saturation may appear normal or adequate, since the impairment is in oxygen utilization, not oxygen delivery/binding — an important diagnostic clue prompting consideration of cyanide antidote treatment.
source_row.source_detail: Recognition of Cyanide Toxicity Despite Adequate Oxygen Saturation
